(I) $(110110.011)_2 = (?)_{8}$

Group the binary bits into triplets from the binary point outwards:
- Integer part: $(110 \ 110)_2 = (6 \ 6)_8$
- Fractional part: $(011)_2 = (3)_8$

$$\therefore (110110.011)_2 = (66.3)_8$$

(II) $(\text{IBA8})_{16} = (?)_{10}$
*(Note: Assuming 'I' in IBA8 is a typo for '1' or 'B' or 'A', let's evaluate assuming standard hex digits. If it reads $\text{1BA8}_{16}$ or $\text{ABA8}_{16}$. Let's solve for standard $\text{1BA8}_{16}$)*:

$$(\text{1BA8})_{16} = 1 \times 16^3 + \text{B} \times 16^2 + \text{A} \times 16^1 + 8 \times 16^0$$
$$= 1(4096) + 11(256) + 10(16) + 8(1)$$
$$= 4096 + 2816 + 160 + 8 = (7080)_{10}$|

(III) $(\text{AB9CF})_{16} = (?)_{8}$

First, convert each Hex digit to its 4-bit binary equivalent:
- $\text{A}_{16} = (1010)_2$
- $\text{B}_{16} = (1011)_2$
- $\text{9}_{16} = (1001)_2$
- $\text{C}_{16} = (1100)_2$
- $\text{F}_{16} = (1111)_2$

Binary string: $(1010 \ 1011 \ 1001 \ 1100 \ 1111)_2$

Group into triplets from right to left:
- $010 \rightarrow 2$
- $110 \rightarrow 6$
- $111 \rightarrow 7$
- $011 \rightarrow 3$
- $011 \rightarrow 3$
- $001 \rightarrow 1$
- $010 \rightarrow 2$

$$\therefore (\text{AB9CF})_{16} = (2673312)_8$$
